descriptionPlain:
Join Tech @ Ro to build the future of healthcare, from the ground up!
At Ro, we believe that when people achieve their health goals, they can achieve their life goals. The highest-leverage way to move society forward is to give people their health, and the current healthcare system isn’t built to do that. It was built to bill, not to serve patients.
We’re building a new system. One where the patient is in control. One designed from scratch for the digital age.
At Ro, technology isn’t just a function… It's core to how we deliver care. We’ve built a vertically integrated healthcare platform that connects telehealth, diagnostics, pharmacy, and logistics into a seamless, end-to-end experience for millions of patients.
…and we’re just getting started. 
As part of Tech @ Ro, you’ll work on systems that operate at scale, with an opportunity to:
Solve complex, high-concurrency problems across a full-stack platform
Build and ship quickly with tight feedback loops and real-world impact
Own systems end-to-end, from architecture to production performance
Work alongside experienced operators, technical leaders, and clinicians
Help define how modern healthcare should be delivered
We’re a performance-driven team with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. We move fast, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for what we build, and do so with a big heart — because patients depend on it.
If you’re motivated by impact, scale, and the chance to help lead the patient revolution, come build with us.


The Role
We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who will supercharge the organization by more fully unlocking Conversational Analytics. You thrive in a startup setting, where every day is different and the problems that you’re tackling don’t have established solutions. 
 
The role will have two primary focuses:
1) building data models/semantic models, documentation, context, and evaluations to strengthen our LLMs’ ability to consistently achieve the correct answers, and 
2) training non-data stakeholders to more efficiently and effectively interact with our data stack. 
 
You will start your time by diving deep into day-to-day analyst work and as you build a strong understanding for how data is used by end stakeholders and build business context. You’ll then transition to building out tooling that allows stakeholders to self-service via Conversational Analytics. You take pride in developing tools, processes, and working frameworks and teaching your colleagues how to use them to better leverage data to generate insights and operationalize data. You have a bias for action, strong communication skills and a continual learning mindset.

lists.content:
• For the first 2-3 months, embed with a stakeholder team to dive into day-to-day analyst work, build stakeholder relationships, and develop business fluence
  • Build foundational data models, semantic models, documentation, and context that power conversational analytics across a variety of data domains (growth, product, business metrics, operations etc.)
  • Approach opaque, unstructured problems by developing core analytic frameworks and standardized semantic models that shape the way the company thinks about our business
  • Communicate and collaborate with different stakeholders to identify opportunities and build solutions that standardize our data approach to common problems across the company
  • Teach and guide stakeholders on best practices for using LLMs for their own data needs, and distill what works into reusable training materials
  • Develop and maintain AI evaluations for conversational analytics, tracking accuracy programmatically and building stakeholder feedback loops

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team
lists.content:
• 4+ years of full-time working experience in quantitative analysis roles, with a portion of that time focused on data modeling in DBT
  • Hands-on experience using LLMs for coding and analytics, going beyond asking simple questions and building data products through LLM workflows
  • Expert-level SQL skills
  • Experience using BI tools (ours are Hex and Looker) to effectively convey information
  • Strong communication and teaching skills
  • Strong problem solving skills, analytical aptitude, and numerical dexterity
  • Demonstrated track record of project ownership

• Experience with AI evaluation of LLM tools
  • Experience developing data pipelines and processes
  • We are open to data analysts with demonstrable interest and project experience who are looking to make the transition to analytics engineer

descriptionPlain:
Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.
 
Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.


The Role:
As an Associate Manager, Clinical Claims, you’ll make sure everything Ro says about its products and services is accurate, evidence-based, and compliant, while helping Marketing say it boldly and defensibly. You’ll review advertising and broader company claims across channels, partnering closely with Marketing, Legal, Regulatory, Clinical, and Product teams and reporting to the Director of Scientific Affairs. You’re a rigorous, curious scientific thinker who can translate complex clinical data into clear, practical guidance. You’ll have the chance to build and own the claims framework, review process, and evidence library as Ro scales.

Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

The Role:

As an Associate Manager, Clinical Claims, you’ll make sure everything Ro says about its products and services is accurate, evidence-based, and compliant, while helping Marketing say it boldly and defensibly. You’ll review advertising and broader company claims across channels, partnering closely with Marketing, Legal, Regulatory, Clinical, and Product teams and reporting to the Director of Scientific Affairs. You’re a rigorous, curious scientific thinker who can translate complex clinical data into clear, practical guidance. You’ll have the chance to build and own the claims framework, review process, and evidence library as Ro scales.

lists.content:
• Review advertising, website content, product pages, packaging, social media, and sales materials to ensure clinical and performance claims are accurate, substantiated, and compliant
  • Evaluate supporting evidence (clinical studies, published literature, consumer research) and determine whether it is strong enough to support each claim
  • Partner with Marketing, Legal, Regulatory, Clinical, and Product to give clear guidance on claim wording, risk level, and any additional substantiation needed
  • Enable bold, defensible marketing by offering workable alternatives and solutions
  • Own and build the claims library and evidence database so approved claims and their supporting data are documented and defensible
  • Establish and refine claims review processes, templates, and approval workflows that scale with the business
  • Success in your first 90 days: learn the portfolio and current review process, audit high-visibility and high-risk claims in market, build relationships with key stakeholders, and propose a prioritized roadmap for process improvements and claims library buildout

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:
lists.content:
• 3 - 5 years of experience in claims substantiation, medical-legal-regulatory (MLR) review, advertising and promotion regulatory affairs, clinical research, or a related field
  • Strong ability to critically appraise clinical data, including study design, sample size, endpoints, and statistical vs. clinical significance
  • Working knowledge of FDA and FTC advertising and labeling standards, including the distinction between structure/function and disease claims
  • Proven experience partnering with Marketing and Legal in a review or approval process
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear, practical guidance for non-scientific audiences
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or health-related field (advanced degree a plus)
  • Bonus points for consulting experience (regulatory, advertising compliance, or life sciences advisory), experience with NAD challenges or regulatory inquiries, or experience building a claims review function from the ground up

• Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Wellbeing + Learning & Growth reimbursements
  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits
  • Pet insurance
  • Student loan refinancing
  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness

lists.content:
• Own and optimize Ro’s Audio and YouTube campaigns across conditions, managing media plans, budgets and ongoing performance against condition-specific acquisition targets.

  • Help build and grow Ro’s endorser ecosystem by proactively identifying high-potential talent and partnership opportunities across podcasts, YouTube and the broader creator landscape.

  • Evaluate and structure new partnership opportunities, assessing media economics, audience fit, historical performance, usage rights, creative potential and expected value to determine where Ro should invest.

  • Develop a proactive partnership pipeline and testing roadmap, identifying new talent, audiences and partnership models that can expand the program beyond its existing portfolio.

  • Manage relationships with Audio and YouTube agencies and external partners, serving as a key day-to-day Ro point of contact and ensuring campaigns launch and operate effectively.

  • Monitor campaign and partner performance and make portfolio recommendations, including where to scale, extend, optimize or exit partnerships based on direct acquisition performance and the broader value of the relationship.

  • Partner closely with Paid Social and Creative teams to extend endorser content, identifying promising footage and concepts and helping translate partnership assets into performative assets.

  • Help shape creative strategy with endorsers and partners, applying learnings from both native placements and Paid Social performance to improve scripts, reads, concepts and future content.

  • Analyze and synthesize media and creative performance, translating campaign data into clear insights and recommendations for budget owners and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Own key operational workflows across the portfolio, including campaign launches, creative briefing, script refreshes, compliance reviews, reporting and budget management.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Audio and YouTube measurement and attribution, including the different signals Ro uses to understand both direct-response and holistic partnership performance.

  • Stay close to the evolving Audio, YouTube and creator landscape, including emerging talent, competitor activity, platform trends and new partnership opportunities that could help differentiate Ro.

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:
lists.content:
• 3- 5 years of experience in performance marketing, media planning/buying, partnerships, growth marketing, or a related field.

  • Experience managing or supporting scaled acquisition programs within a marketing program with budgets of $3M+/month.

  • Experience across one or more relevant media channels such as Audio (radio + podcasts), YouTube, creator partnerships, TV/CTV, or other Offline acquisition channels.

  • A genuine interest in creators, endorsers, podcasts, YouTube and the broader media landscape, with an instinct for identifying talent and content that could resonate with an audience.

  • Strong performance-marketing instincts and comfort using metrics such as CAC, response rate and conversion performance to evaluate campaigns and make optimization recommendations.

As the Director of Learning & Development on Ro's Care Delivery team, you will own the learning strategy and programs supporting hundreds of clinical and non-clinical patient-facing team members. You will ensure our teams have the knowledge, skills, and resources to deliver high-quality patient care at scale, from onboarding and new program launches to ongoing development, performance improvement, and retraining.
You will build the systems, processes, and infrastructure that enable Learning & Development to operate effectively as our business evolves. This includes establishing how we identify and prioritize learning needs, develop and maintain content, scale learning across teams, and measure whether learning translates into the expected behaviors and performance outcomes. You will partner closely with Clinical, Operations, Quality & Safety, Product, and other cross-functional leaders to ensure learning investments address the right problems and drive measurable impact.
You are a strategic and operational leader who knows how to build a scalable learning function in a fast-moving, complex environment. You bring strong judgment about when training is the right solution, a data-driven approach to improving frontline performance, and the ability to build and lead a high-performing team. You are a complexity buster - able to distill the most complex clinical or technical concepts to acceptable learning content. You are equally comfortable setting long-term direction, establishing practical systems and processes, and driving execution through your team and cross-functional partners.

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:

descriptionBody:
As the Director of Learning & Development on Ro's Care Delivery team, you will own the learning strategy and programs supporting hundreds of clinical and non-clinical patient-facing team members. You will ensure our teams have the knowledge, skills, and resources to deliver high-quality patient care at scale, from onboarding and new program launches to ongoing development, performance improvement, and retraining.

You will build the systems, processes, and infrastructure that enable Learning & Development to operate effectively as our business evolves. This includes establishing how we identify and prioritize learning needs, develop and maintain content, scale learning across teams, and measure whether learning translates into the expected behaviors and performance outcomes. You will also own the evaluation and adoption of learning technologies and tools, ensuring the team is equipped to operate efficiently and stays at the forefront of adult learning practices, emerging technologies, and innovative approaches to learning. You will partner closely with Clinical, Operations, Quality & Safety, Product, and other cross-functional leaders to ensure learning investments address the right problems and drive measurable impact.

You are a strategic and operational leader who knows how to build a scalable learning function in a fast-moving, complex environment. You bring strong judgment about when training is the right solution, a data-driven approach to improving frontline performance, and the ability to build and lead a high-performing team. You are a complexity buster - able to distill the most complex clinical or technical concepts to acceptable learning content. You are equally comfortable setting long-term direction, establishing practical systems and processes, and driving execution through your team and cross-functional partners.

Ro is looking for a Director of Integrated Marketing to lead the development and execution of our highest-priority integrated marketing campaigns.
This is a senior, hands-on role for a marketer who knows how to take a strong creative idea into a cohesive campaign that reaches consumers across paid, owned, and earned channels. You’ll bring together Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, Communications, Insights, and other channel teams around a shared campaign strategy and ensure that every part of the campaign works together to maximize its impact.
You’ll be accountable for integrated campaigns from early strategy and planning through launch and performance assessment. You’ll propose how an idea should come to life across channels, identify the moments and tactics that can make it bigger, establish the campaign plan and operating cadence, and drive alignment among the cross-functional team and prioritize exceptional execution.
At Ro, Directors are both leaders and operators. This role will initially be an individual contributor, but will have significant cross-functional leadership responsibility. You should be equally comfortable shaping the strategy for a major campaign and getting into the details required to make it successful.
This position is a hybrid role in our RoHQ in New York City.

You’ll be accountable for integrated campaigns from early strategy and planning through launch and performance assessment. At Ro, Directors are both leaders and operators. This role will initially be an individual contributor, but will have significant cross-functional leadership responsibility. lists.content:
Lead Ro's highest-priority integrated campaigns

  • Own the integrated marketing strategy and execution for major consumer campaigns, including celebrity partnerships, brand moments, and other high-priority launches.

  • Translate campaign objectives, audience insights, product claims, and an aligned creative concept into a clear integrated marketing strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels.

  • Identify opportunities to maximize a creative concept across channels, ensuring we're not simply adapting the same idea everywhere but taking advantage of what each channel can uniquely contribute.

  • Build the campaign architecture: define the role of each channel, key moments, sequencing, dependencies, and how the pieces work together to create greater impact.

  • Maintain a holistic view of the consumer experience and ensure campaigns feel cohesive wherever consumers encounter Ro.

    • Orchestrate cross-functional teams

  • Serve as the single accountable marketing lead for assigned integrated campaigns, bringing together teams across Brand, Product Marketing, Growth,Communications, and other functions.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to understand the consumer insight, value proposition, and product claims we can credibly bring to market.

  • Partner closely with Brand as they develop the creative concept, helping pressure-test how ideas can extend across channels and identifying opportunities to maximize the concept once aligned.

  • Partner with channel owners to determine how the campaign should come to life within their channels, bringing their expertise into the integrated strategy rather than prescribing channel execution.

  • Create clarity across complex initiatives by establishing priorities, roles, decision points, dependencies, timelines, and operating rhythms.

  • Anticipate risks and resolve cross-functional blockers before they compromise the quality or timing of a launch.

    • Raise the bar for integrated marketing at Ro

  • Develop a repeatable approach to integrated campaign planning that enables teams to move quickly without sacrificing strategic rigor or executional excellence.

  • Push teams to think beyond individual channel deliverables and identify opportunities for ideas to build on one another across the entire campaign.

  • Bring a strong point of view on what makes integrated consumer marketing effective and help evolve how Ro shows up during our biggest marketing moments.

  • Create strong feedback loops after launches, partnering with channel teams to understand performance and translating those learnings into better future campaigns.

    • Be a hands-on leader

  • Personally drive the work required to move campaigns from strategy through execution rather than relying on a large team to do it for you.

  • Move fluidly between strategic thinking and executional detail—from determining how a campaign should show up across the consumer journey to resolving an issue that could put a launch at risk.

  • Lead through influence, building trust and alignment across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.

  • Operate comfortably in ambiguity and bring structure and momentum to complex, fast-moving initiatives.

• 10+ years of experience in integrated marketing, brand marketing, consumer marketing, or related roles, within a high-growth consumer, DTC, or digitally native business.

  • A track record of personally leading large, cross-channel consumer campaigns from strategy through launch, with clear examples of the role you played and the impact the work had.

  • Experience orchestrating campaigns across a mix of paid, owned, and earned channels, with enough fluency across disciplines to connect the work while respecting the expertise of functional channel owners.

  • Strong consumer and creative judgment. You know what makes an idea compelling and can identify opportunities to make a strong creative concept work harder across channels without needing to be the person who develops the creative concept.

  • Experience partnering closely with Brand/Creative, Product Marketing, Growth/Performance Marketing, Social, Communications/PR, and Lifecycle/CRM teams.

  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership. You can create alignment, make decisions, resolve ambiguity, and hold teams accountable without relying on reporting lines.

  • Strong operational instincts and attention to detail. You know that exceptional campaigns require both a strong idea and excellent execution.

  • Experience operating in a lean, fast-moving organization where senior leaders are expected to both set direction and execute.

  • Low ego and high ownership. No part of getting an important campaign successfully into market is beneath you.

    • In your first year, you'll have established yourself as the person Ro turns to when we need to bring a major marketing moment to market exceptionally well.

    Our highest-priority campaigns will have a clear integrated strategy, stronger coordination across teams and channels, and a cohesive consumer experience from first exposure through conversion and beyond. Brand will have a partner who helps maximize great creative ideas across the full marketing ecosystem; channel owners will have clarity on how their work contributes to the larger campaign; and Product Marketing will be able to maintain deeper focus on product positioning, claims, launches, and channel strategy rather than serving as the operational owner of every major campaign.

descriptionPlain:
Join Tech @ Ro to build the future of healthcare, from the ground up!
At Ro, we believe that when people achieve their health goals, they can achieve their life goals. The highest-leverage way to move society forward is to give people their health, and the current healthcare system isn’t built to do that. It was built to bill, not to serve patients.
We’re building a new system. One where the patient is in control. One designed from scratch for the digital age.
At Ro, technology isn’t just a function… It's core to how we deliver care. We’ve built a vertically integrated healthcare platform that connects telehealth, diagnostics, pharmacy, and logistics into a seamless, end-to-end experience for millions of patients.
…and we’re just getting started. 
As part of Tech @ Ro, you’ll work on systems that operate at scale, with an opportunity to:
Solve complex, high-concurrency problems across a full-stack platform
Build and ship quickly with tight feedback loops and real-world impact
Own systems end-to-end, from architecture to production performance
Work alongside experienced operators, technical leaders, and clinicians
Help define how modern healthcare should be delivered
We’re a performance-driven team with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. We move fast, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for what we build, and do so with a big heart — because patients depend on it.
If you’re motivated by impact, scale, and the chance to help lead the patient revolution, come build with us.


The Role
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Core Infrastructure.
This role is for a hands-on engineering leader who can create leverage through managing people, own execution, and bring strong technical and operational judgment to production systems. You will own a portfolio and lead a team responsible for scaling Ro’s infrastructure for increasing scale and AI-driven engineering workflows, while reducing system surface area, eliminating legacy complexity, and improving reliability and cost efficiency.
Infrastructure plays a foundational role in Ro’s ability to help patients reach their health goals by making the systems behind their care more reliable, scalable, secure, and efficient.
The right person will help the team balance reactive support with durable systems ownership: solving common needs once, reducing operational drag, and creating a high-context, high-trust environment where engineers can do their best work.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Core Infrastructure.

This role is for a hands-on engineering leader who can create leverage through managing people, own execution, and bring strong technical and operational judgment to production systems. You will own a portfolio and lead a team responsible for scaling Ro’s infrastructure for increasing scale and AI-driven engineering workflows, while reducing system surface area, eliminating legacy complexity, and improving reliability and cost efficiency.

Infrastructure plays a foundational role in Ro’s ability to help patients reach their health goals by making the systems behind their care more reliable, scalable, secure, and efficient.

The right person will help the team balance reactive support with durable systems ownership: solving common needs once, reducing operational drag, and creating a high-context, high-trust environment where engineers can do their best work.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop a Core Infrastructure team responsible for production-critical systems and foundational engineering capabilities.
  • Own execution across the team’s portfolio: clarify priorities, sequence work, manage tradeoffs, and ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Improve Ro’s infrastructure operating model by making ownership clearer, reducing recurring support burden, and converting operational pain into durable system improvements.
  • Advance Ro’s reliability, observability, and disaster recovery posture through better operational practices, clearer readiness expectations, incident learning, and resilient infrastructure patterns.
  • Partner with Product Engineering, Cyber, Data Infrastructure, and Infrastructure leadership to ensure Core Infrastructure work improves reliability, velocity, compliance, unit economics, and the systems that help patients access and stay engaged in care.
  • Create a high-context, high-trust team environment with clear expectations, strong feedback/accountability loops, and space for engineers to do their best work.

• Experience leading infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps, backend, or production engineering teams in a cloud-native environment.
  • Strong technical judgment across production infrastructure systems such as AWS, Kubernetes, serverless/Lambda architectures, Cloudflare or edge infrastructure, observability platforms like Datadog, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Pulumi or Terraform.
  • Experience improving operational systems such as on-call health, incident response, service ownership, reliability practices, disaster recovery readiness, documentation, and production support workflows.
  • Experience operating infrastructure in regulated environments is a plus, especially where reliability, security, auditability, and HIPAA-adjacent considerations shape technical decisions.
  • Comfort operating as a hands-on technical leader: close enough to architecture, incidents, reliability risks, cost drivers, and implementation tradeoffs to unblock decisions and raise the quality of execution.
  • A pragmatic, forward-looking approach to new technologies, including AI-assisted engineering and operations. You are willing to experiment with emerging approaches such as AI-directed SRE investigations, incident analysis, operational automation, and developer productivity improvements while maintaining appropriate judgment around safety, reliability, and governance.
  • Ability to convert ambiguous or recurring infrastructure problems into clear plans, scoped engineering work, and measurable outcomes.
  • A management style that combines high standards with high support: you create clarity, build trust, develop engineers, and hold the team accountable for outcomes.

The Role:

As an Engineering Manager on the Ro Patient Experience team, you’ll be responsible for the surface areas that support millions of patients in  their treatment journey - everything from coordinating treatment plans with their provider to receiving counseling and support from their care team. You’ll own engineering execution and direction for a highly visible product area, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and engineering teams across Ro to turn complex and sometimes ambiguous patient needs into intuitive experiences. You’ll be a strong people leader who remains close to the work, bringing the product judgment, technical depth, and bias toward action needed to help the team make decisions and deliver. This role is well suited to someone who is comfortable creating clarity amid ambiguity, navigating a range of stakeholder perspectives, and taking ownership beyond the traditional boundaries of engineering management.

lists.content:
• Set the technical and execution direction for a full-stack team that brings together capabilities and services from across Ro into a cohesive, intuitive patient experience
  • Shape the strategy and evolution of AI-enabled patient experiences across Ro, balancing rapid iteration with reliability, technical quality, and patient trust.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to translate complex healthcare workflows and underlying systems into experiences that feel simple and useful to patients
  • Turn ambiguous patient and business problems into clear priorities and executable plans, defining a path forward even when requirements, ownership, or success metrics are still evolving
  • Work across engineering teams to connect the systems that power the patient experience, identify gaps and dependencies, and ensure the patient experience remains coherent even when the underlying capabilities have multiple owners
  • Stay close to execution — coaching and developing engineers while digging into technical decisions, product tradeoffs, patient feedback, and data when needed to unblock the team and drive critical initiatives forward

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:
lists.content:
• Experience leading and developing high-performing engineering teams, with a track record of coaching engineers, setting clear expectations, and creating an environment where teams can do their best work
  • Demonstrated ownership of meaningful consumer-facing products or experiences, with the ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes
  • Strong product and UX instincts and a desire to build experiences that make complex underlying systems feel simple and intuitive to users
  • Technical depth and judgment that allow you to engage meaningfully in architecture and implementation decisions, challenge assumptions, and effectively support senior engineers
  • A track record of operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and creating clarity and momentum without waiting for every dependency or decision to be resolved
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, including experience aligning stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities
  • Experience driving work across teams and systems you don’t directly control, using influence and sound judgment to move complex initiatives forward
  • Technical fluency with React and TypeScript, along with experience working with Python or similar backend technologies.
  • A data-driven approach to product development, with experience defining success measures, using data to evaluate impact, and iterating based on what you learn.

• Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Wellbeing + Learning & Growth stipends
  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits
  • Pet insurance
  • Student loan refinancing
  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness

lists.content:

descriptionPlain:
About RPM
 
Roman Pennsylvania Medical, P.C. (RPM) is a telehealth practice dedicated to providing high-quality, patient-centric care. RPM is part of the provider network affiliated with Ro, a direct-to-patient healthcare company. Providers help patients seeking care through Ro’s platform for their mental health, women’s health, men’s health, fertility, metabolic health, and skincare needs.
 
RPM providers benefit from using technology, tools, and solutions designed to support safe and appropriate care, reduce administrative burden, and help them seamlessly connect with patients throughout their care journeys. As part of RPM’s affiliation with Ro, providers help expand access to affordable, high-quality care to more patients. RPM’s nationwide network of providers is made up of board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and nurses licensed to treat patients in all 50 states and Washington, DC.


Are you a physician who is passionate about helping patients achieve their health goals? Do you want to use your expertise to improve patient outcomes from the comfort of your own home? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you! We are seeking a talented and experienced Virtual Physician to join our team and provide telemedicine (remote medical consultation) services to patients who are seeking prescription weight management treatment. You will support our comprehensive Body Program, that combines prescription GLP-1 treatment (for patients who are eligible) with care management and coaching from RNs, education, and progress tracking. We'd love for you to join us and be a part of this exciting time at Ro.

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:

Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.

As a Lead Compounding Pharmacy Technician you will be responsible to oversee the daily operations of our non-sterile compounding team, with a focus on both hazardous and non-hazardous medication preparation at our Romeoville, IL facility.  This role is pivotal in ensuring that all compounding activities are performed safely, accurately, and in full compliance with applicable regulations and internal standards, including adherence to proper  protocols, standard of operations and safety procedures. As Lead Compounding Technician, you will be responsible for managing and supporting a team of technicians by coordinating daily workflows, overseeing scheduling, maintaining inventory, and ensuring consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). You will play a key role in technician training and development, performance monitoring, and operational troubleshooting.
 
Working closely with the Lead Compounding Pharmacist and under pharmacist supervision, you’ll help drive a culture of excellence in pharmaceutical compounding, while also partnering with cross-functional teams to address operational needs and ensure an exceptional experience for our patients.
 
This posting is for our location in Romeoville, Illinois. This hire is for a full time role.

lists.content:
• Direct and oversee daily operations of the compounding technician team, ensuring efficient execution of workflows and shift coverage
  • Lead performance management efforts, including coaching, conducting regular 1:1s, and delivering feedback to drive accountability and growth
  • Own technician training and development; implement onboarding, enforce adherence to SOPs, and ensure competency in gowning and hazardous drug handling
  • Supervise and perform the compounding of non-sterile hazardous and non-hazardous medications, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and quality standards
  • Establish and maintain a clean, safe, and inspection-ready work environment through leadership in sanitation and compliance practices
  • Work closely with Lead Compounding Pharmacist resolving operational issues related to compounding, meeting order demand and quality
  • Partner closely with the Lead Compounding Pharmacist and PIC to ensure ongoing compliance with USP <795>, <800>, and all federal and state pharmacy regulations
  • Act as a key cross-functional liaison to supply chain, engineering, quality, and product teams to drive process improvements and operational scalability
  • Collaborates with key administrative functions including technician scheduling, inventory management, and cycle counts; ensure timely and thorough training of all staff with proper documentation; develop and track team metrics and performance goals to drive operational excellence and accountability

• Licensed Pharmacy Technician in the state of Illinois; PTCB certified
  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years of pharmacy technician experience, with prior leadership or supervisory experience strongly preferred
  • Ability to work on site 40 hours per week (Monday-Friday) plus rotating weekends
  • Proven experience in non-sterile compounding, including hazardous and non-hazardous drug preparation, with a strong understanding of USP <795> and <800> guidelines
  • Demonstrated leadership ability with experience training, mentoring, and managing pharmacy technicians in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills, with experience in scheduling, inventory control, cycle counts, and documentation management
  • Deep knowledge of proper gowning techniques, PPE usage, and safe handling practices for hazardous materials
  • A commitment to quality, accuracy, and compliance, with the ability to enforce SOPs and uphold regulatory standards
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with pharmacists, cross-functional teams, and direct reports
  • Proactive problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify process improvements and implement practical solutions

• This is a full-time role with shifts primarily scheduled Monday through Friday, plus every other Saturday. A rotation system is in place to ensure fair distribution of weekend shifts

lists.content:
• Lead and mentor a team of pharmacy technicians by providing hands-on coaching, real-time feedback, and performance support to foster a high-performing team culture
  • Oversee technician onboarding, training, and ongoing skills development to ensure compliance with SOPs and operational excellence
  • Support scheduling and staffing needs to ensure appropriate shift coverage and workflow continuity
  • Ensure pharmacy fulfillment workflows—including picking, packing, and shipping—are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established timelines
  • Act as the primary point of contact for daily operational issues on the floor, escalating concerns to pharmacy leadership as appropriate
  • Collaborate closely with pharmacists and cross-functional teams including operations, care, and product to resolve order and shipping issues promptly

  • Support additional operational tasks and responsibilities as assigned by pharmacy leadership

lists.text: What You'll Bring to the Team:
lists.content:

  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate, guide, and support a team in a fast-paced fulfillment environment
  • Empathy, patience, and professionalism in interactions with both patients and team members
  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making abilities, especially when navigating high-pressure or time-sensitive situations
  • Excellent organizational skills and a sharp attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and compliance
  • Comfort working with pharmacy automation equipment and technology-driven workflows
  • A proactive, improvement-oriented mindset and the ability to contribute to cross-functional problem-solving
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and a collaborative spirit that thrives in cross-functional environments

• While we strive to maintain consistent schedules, flexibility is required, as your scheduled workdays may occasionally shift to help cover holidays, team PTO, or other staffing needs
  • Advanced notice of at least two weeks will be provided for any changes to the regular schedule

• Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible PTO

  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits
  • Pet insurance
  • Student loan refinancing
  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness

lists.content:
• Serve as an internal subject matter expert on  FTC and FDA advertising and marketing issues as they pertain to health products.
  • Review and advise on product claims and claim substantiation including scientific studies, clinical data, consumer perception research, product testing, and other supporting evidence to assess the level of support required for proposed claims and evaluate regulatory and legal risk.
  • Sit on Ro’s collaborative medical-legal-regulatory-marketing review team to support advertising review.  
  • Assess the legal and regulatory risk associated with proposed claims and recommend appropriate revisions, qualifications, or additional substantiation.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support new strategic initiatives and advertising campaigns.
  • Stay abreast of developments in FDA and FTC regulations, state laws,  and industry trends in advertising, and monitor enforcement actions and relevant litigation.
  • Maintain documentation of claim reviews, supporting evidence, and substantiation assessments.

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:
lists.content:
• Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.
  • Active member in good standing of a state bar association.
  • 5+years of experience advising on product claims and claim substantiation of FDA-or FTC-regulated products.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating scientific and clinical evidence to substantiate advertising claims, including assessing study design, endpoints, statistical findings, and the extent to which evidence supports proposed consumer-facing claims.
  • Strong knowledge of FTC advertising substantiation standards, including express and implied claims, competent and reliable scientific evidence, comparative advertising, misleading net impression, influencer advertising, and pricing laws.
  • Familiarity with FTC enforcement actions, Lanham Act challenges, consumer false advertising litigation, and NAD proceedings.
  • Exceptional analytical, research, and writing skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Business-oriented mindset with the ability to translate legal advice into practical solutions.
  • Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Passion for the telehealth industry and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

• Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Wellbeing stipend
  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits
  • Pet insurance
  • Student loan refinancing
  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness
    • We welcome qualified candidates of all races, creeds, genders, and sexuality to apply.

lists.content:
• Package and ship outbound patient orders accurately and efficiently in accordance with company SOPs
  • Prepare shipments, including building boxes and assembling packaging materials, to ensure timely dispatch and delivery expectations are met

  • Occasionally operate manual  pallet jacks to move materials and support workflow across the facility
  • Maintain accurate inventory levels through proper stocking and organization practices

  • Collaborate with team members to meet daily shipping targets and operational deadlines

lists.content:

  • Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with team members to meet daily shipping goals
  • Willingness to learn, take direction, and support both outbound and inbound operations as needed
  • Proactive, dependable, and team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability
  • Dependable and punctual, with a strong work ethic and team-oriented mindset
  • Long periods of standing, must be able to bend at the waist and knee, and occasionally lift up to 50 lbs

descriptionPlain:
About RPM
 
Roman Pennsylvania Medical, P.C. (RPM) is a telehealth practice dedicated to providing high-quality, patient-centric care. RPM is part of the provider network affiliated with Ro, a direct-to-patient healthcare company. Providers help patients seeking care through Ro’s platform for their mental health, women’s health, men’s health, fertility, metabolic health, and skincare needs.
 
RPM providers benefit from using technology, tools, and solutions designed to support safe and appropriate care, reduce administrative burden, and help them seamlessly connect with patients throughout their care journeys. As part of RPM’s affiliation with Ro, providers help expand access to affordable, high-quality care to more patients. RPM’s nationwide network of providers is made up of board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and nurses licensed to treat patients in all 50 states and Washington, DC.


Are you a physician who is passionate about helping patients achieve their health goals? Do you want to use your expertise to improve patient outcomes from the comfort of your own home? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you! We are seeking a talented and experienced Virtual Physician to join our team and provide telemedicine (remote medical consultation) services to patients who are seeking prescription weight management treatment. You will support our comprehensive Body Program, that combines prescription GLP-1 treatment (for patients who are eligible) with care management and coaching from RNs, education, and progress tracking. We'd love for you to join us and be a part of this exciting time at Ro.

lists.content:
• Conduct consultations via phone, video, or asynchronously based on state telemedicine regulations
  • Provide care using our custom EMR: evaluating patient records, diagnosing, and prescribing medication, and making lifestyle recommendations
  • Follow best practices and company specific policies for diagnosis, treatment, and documentation
  • Answer patient questions related to their treatment and provide high quality counseling

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:
lists.content:
• Board Certification in either Internal Medicine or Family Medicine (other specialities can be considered)
  • Board certification in Obesity Medicine or board eligibility and will need to sit for the exam in 2026
  • 2 years of post-residency experience
  • Telemedicine experience and comfort with asynchronous care
  • Experience with weight management / GLP-1 medication is a plus
  • At least 10 active state medical licenses, including at least 1 of the following states: California, Florida, New York, Texas, Georgia and at least 1 of these states Virginia, Kansas, Minnesota, Delaware, New Mexico, Rhode Island, Vermont, West Virginia and Wyoming
  • Willingness to obtain additional medical licenses based on practice needs
  • IMLC licensed or eligible is a plus
    •  
    Bonus points for the following state licenses:
  • Arkansas
  • Missouri
  • New Jersey
  • North Carolina
  • South Carolina
  • Utah
  • Pennsylvania
  • Connecticut
  • New Hampshire
  • Massachusetts

• 4, 5-hour shifts working daytime on Saturday and Sunday, and evenings on Monday and Tuesday 
  • Weekend blocks can be divided into 1-2 hour blocks throughout the day
  • Synchronous and asynchronous care
  • 100% direct patient care

As part of Tech @ Ro, you’ll work on systems that operate at scale, with an opportunity to:

Own systems end-to-end, from architecture to production performance
Work alongside experienced operators, technical leaders, and clinicians
Help define how modern healthcare should be delivered
We’re a performance-driven team with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. We move fast, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for what we build, and do so with a big heart — because patients depend on it.

The Role
 
We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to serve as a senior technical leader across Ro’s engineering organization. In this role, you’ll help shape the long-term direction of our platform, guide the evolution of critical systems, and drive architectural decisions that enable Ro to scale safely, sustainably, and quickly. 

You’ll partner across engineering, product, design, and cross-functional leadership to define technical strategy, anticipate risks, mentor senior engineers, and guide teams toward resilient, maintainable, high-quality solutions. This role is ideal for someone energized by system-wide impact, complex technical challenges, and helping raise the engineering bar across Ro.

lists.content:
• Define and drive the architectural vision for key systems and platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, resilience, and long-term maintainability.
  • Evaluate and recommend foundational technologies, patterns, and practices that position Ro for future growth.
  • Translate complex, ambiguous problem spaces into clear technical roadmaps, identifying tradeoffs and guiding teams toward strategic solutions.
  • Lead organization-wide initiatives that improve system health, observability, performance, security, and operational excellence.
  • Partner with product, design, data, and other teams to align technical strategy with business priorities.
  • Break down large, multi-team initiatives into actionable plans and drive them from concept to delivery.
  • Mentor and support Staff, Senior, and early-career engineers in both technical and strategic growth.
  • Foster a culture of high-quality engineering, thoughtful design, rigorous review, and continuous learning.
  • Provide technical leadership in design reviews, architecture discussions, and cross-team forums.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leadership and cross-functional partners.

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team
lists.content:
• 12+ years of experience building scalable, maintainable software systems
  • A proven track record of technical leadership across multiple teams or domains, including designing and evolving complex distributed systems.
  • Deep expertise in backend engineering (preferably with a strong proficiency in Python) and experience with distributed systems and relational databases.
  • Experience in metrics instrumentation and data-driven performance tuning, leveraging load testing infrastructure and tools like Datadog.
  • Strong architectural skills with the ability to reason about long-term tradeoffs, system interactions, operational risks, and platform evolution.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy, drive alignment across multiple teams, and guide organizations through ambiguity.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A passion for and strong track record of developing other engineers and raising the technical bar through mentorship, coaching, and leadership.
• Experience in telehealth or other highly-regulated industries.

  • Flexible PTO
  • Wellbeing + Learning & Growth reimbursements

  • Pet insurance

Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.
 
Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.


Ro is hosting an interview day at our brand new, state-of-the-art facility in Romeoville, IL!  
 
Come see what a career beyond the counter can look like. Our new facility integrates technology, automation, and clinical expertise in innovative ways, helping us to deliver even greater value and health outcomes to our hundreds of thousands of patients. It has been designed from the ground up with modern workflows and automation. This infrastructure will allow us to meet our patients’ needs today and in the future.
 
Where? Our facility in Romeoville, IL

What to expect? Come curious. Meet a Ro’er. See how your work can support patient care nationwide. 
 
Hit “Apply” below to RSVP and stay in the loop. We’ll follow up with additional event details as we get closer.
 
We’d love the chance to meet you!

descriptionPlain:
About RPM
 
Roman Pennsylvania Medical, P.C. (RPM) is a telehealth practice dedicated to providing high-quality, patient-centric care. RPM is part of the provider network affiliated with Ro, a direct-to-patient healthcare company. Providers help patients seeking care through Ro’s platform for their mental health, women’s health, men’s health, fertility, metabolic health, and skincare needs.
 
RPM providers benefit from using technology, tools, and solutions designed to support safe and appropriate care, reduce administrative burden, and help them seamlessly connect with patients throughout their care journeys. As part of RPM’s affiliation with Ro, providers help expand access to affordable, high-quality care to more patients. RPM’s nationwide network of providers is made up of board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and nurses licensed to treat patients in all 50 states and Washington, DC.


As a 6-month contracted Virtual Registered Nurse, you’ll partner with RPM Providers and work independently to provide high-quality patient care through EMR messaging and communications, and triage to ensure safety, productivity, and team optimization are maintained at the practice level. You are passionate about working in non-traditional healthcare settings and expanding patient access. You can troubleshoot challenging situations as they arise and ensure high-quality patient care is provided per RPM principles and guidelines. You will report to an RN Lead throughout the length of your contract.
 
Who are you? That's a great question. You are a Virtual Registered Nurse who refuses to settle for the status quo. You apply your nursing knowledge and your desire to help people live happier, more productive lives to your daily work. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, you are highly technologically savvy, and you are a problem solver who enjoys working collaboratively with others. We don’t expect you to know everything about medicine or telemedicine, but we do expect you to be ready to dive in and learn.

lists.content:
• Provide comprehensive clinical care by independently managing direct patient needs, including message triage, counseling, and education to patients in our sexual health and metabolic health care verticals.
  • Complete tasks such as side effect management, efficacy counseling, and overall clinical practice support.
  • Coordinate care effectively by triaging and escalating patient concerns to the appropriate provider groups (Staff RNs, Practitioners, Customer Care, Patient Advocates) according to Ro guidelines.
  • Triage patient queries and adverse event reports, ensuring they are routed to the patient’s physician, NP, or medical leadership as needed.
  • Utilize our custom EMR system to answer basic medical questions, educate patients on their conditions and treatments, and offer guidance on lifestyle recommendations and holistic therapies.
  • Adhere to best practices and company-specific policies for nursing care and treatment.
  • Review lab results using approved protocols to provide targeted lifestyle coaching and patient education for weight management.
  • Serve as a resource for the non-clinical Care Team, addressing day-to-day clinical questions and concerns.

• BSN (Bachelor of Science in Nursing)
  • Active, unencumbered Compact Nursing License
  • Bonus points for active, unencumbered Non-Compact Nursing Licenses (AK, CA, DC, HI, IL, MA, MI, MN, NV, NY, OR)
  • 4 years of clinical experience as an RN
  • Experience in a fast-paced, highly iterative clinical care role
  • Will be required to work on some holidays

  • Strong Clinical Judgment: Applies clinical guidelines effectively to routine patient scenarios and escalates appropriately when needed
  • Empathetic & Effective Patient Communication: Communicates clearly, empathetically, and professionally
  • High Quality Care Delivery: Adheres consistently to clinical, documentation, and regulatory standards. Delivers accurate, timely, and safe care, while balancing quality metrics. Uses appropriate judgment around follow-up and escalation
  • Tech-Enabled: Navigates synchronous and asynchronous workflows safely while effectively leveraging technology

• Medical benefits through an Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement (ICHRA), beginning the first day of the calendar month following your 60th day of employment
  • 401(k) with company match

lists.content:

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team:

The Role

Ro is building a team focused on shipping LLM-powered products across the patient experience, clinical operations, and internal tooling.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer, Applied AI to join a new team we’re building from the ground up alongside a Senior AI Lead and an Engineering Manager. You'll own AI features from prototype through production and spend as much time improving workflows with clinical operators as writing code. Most of your work will involve building orchestration layers, prompts, evaluations, retrieval systems, and tooling that make LLMs reliable enough for real-world healthcare operations.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and ship production LLM powered features end-to-end. 
  • Build the AI application layer, including prompt orchestration, tool calling, retrieval (RAG), embeddings, agent workflows, and structured outputs.
  • Develop evaluation infrastructure, including regression suites, LLM-as-a-judge evaluations, synthetic datasets, human review workflows, and quality metrics that catch regressions before users do.
  • Design observability systems that measure accuracy, latency, cost, hallucination rates, and model behavior in production.
  • Build safety and reliability guardrails that ensure AI systems meet quality, compliance, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party tools, including orchestration frameworks, evaluation platforms, vector databases, and model providers; and make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Raise engineering standards across the team through technical leadership, code reviews, mentorship, and thoughtful system design.
  • Sit with EHR operators, Patient Advocates, and clinical teams to understand the workflows you're automating.
  • Prototype quickly, ship early, measure outcomes, and iterate based on real-world usage.

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team
lists.content:
• 5+ years building production software, with at least 1–2 years building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production (or equivalent depth through substantial side projects or open-source work).
  • Strong Python engineer with experience building backend services and integrating modern AI APIs and frameworks.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • You've shipped AI features that served real users, and you can clearly articulate how you measured quality, reliability, latency, cost, and business impact.
  • You have strong product instincts and thrive in ambiguous environments, translating operational problems into technical solutions without relying on detailed specifications.
  • Bonus: Experience with orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AgentCore), RAG architectures, vector databases, prompt/version management, and evaluation or observability platforms (e.g., LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix).

In this role, you’ll work closely with the Sr. Payroll Manager and cross-functional partners across People, Legal, and Finance to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing. You’ll support and help lead key workflows such as tax registrations, payroll reconciliations, and reporting, and contribute to high-impact projects like system migrations and process improvements. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to deepen their expertise in payroll while helping build out a best-in-class function with high visibility across the company.

lists.content:
• Process semi-monthly and biweekly payroll across multiple states and entities. 

  • Support and execute payroll changes, including complex pay calculations, adjustments, deductions, compensation updates, employee status changes, address/work location changes, and wage garnishments. 

  • Execute time and attendance processing, ensuring seamless integration with payroll systems.

  • Review payroll outputs for accuracy and resolve discrepancies.

  • Respond to employee inquiries and collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues.

  • Support payroll tax compliance, including responding to tax notices, maintaining unemployment tax rates, coordinating new state tax registrations (SUI/withholding), assisting with timely filings and remittances, and staying current on U.S. payroll regulations.

  • Audit 401(k) deferrals each pay cycle and prepare control totals.

  • Assist with payroll audits, reporting, employment verifications, and administrative tasks. 

  • Assist with special projects, process improvements, documentation, and updates to payroll procedures. 

  • Support year-end payroll activities.

  • Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and efficiency, support the implementation of best practices, and collaborate with the Sr. Payroll Manager on recommendations to senior management.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

lists.text: What You’ll bring to the Team:
lists.content:
• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field (preferred). 

  • 5 + years of hands-on-payroll experience, ideally in a high-growth or complex environment.

  • Prior experience processing payroll across multiple entities and jurisdictions. 

  • Experience with end-to-end payroll and timekeeping processes, resolving related issues, and ensuring compliance with payroll regulations.

  • Strong organizational,  problem solving skills, and communication skills (both verbal and written).

  • Ability to cultivate effective working relationships (both remotely and in-person) and communicate cross-functionally across all levels of management.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., functions, pivot tables, macros)

  • Experience with payroll systems such as UKG is a plus.

• Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership

  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Wellbeing + Learning & Growth reimbursements

  • Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits

  • Pet insurance

  • Student loan refinancing

  • Virtual resources for mindfulness, counseling, and fitness

descriptionPlain:
Join Tech @ Ro to build the future of healthcare, from the ground up!
At Ro, we believe that when people achieve their health goals, they can achieve their life goals. The highest-leverage way to move society forward is to give people their health, and the current healthcare system isn’t built to do that. It was built to bill, not to serve patients.
We’re building a new system. One where the patient is in control. One designed from scratch for the digital age.
At Ro, technology isn’t just a function… It's core to how we deliver care. We’ve built a vertically integrated healthcare platform that connects telehealth, diagnostics, pharmacy, and logistics into a seamless, end-to-end experience for millions of patients.
…and we’re just getting started. 
As part of Tech @ Ro, you’ll work on systems that operate at scale, with an opportunity to:
Solve complex, high-concurrency problems across a full-stack platform
Build and ship quickly with tight feedback loops and real-world impact
Own systems end-to-end, from architecture to production performance
Work alongside experienced operators, technical leaders, and clinicians
Help define how modern healthcare should be delivered
We’re a performance-driven team with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. We move fast, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for what we build, and do so with a big heart — because patients depend on it.
If you’re motivated by impact, scale, and the chance to help lead the patient revolution, come build with us.


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us at Ro. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and other teams to define, build, and iterate on features that directly impact patient onboarding, care delivery, and insurance workflows.
 
You’ll own backend systems that power critical patient and provider experiences — not just from a technical perspective, but from a product and business outcomes lens. You’ll refine ambiguous problems through solution design, implementation, experimentation, and iteration while ensuring the backend is performant and monitoring for real-world feature engagement and adoption.
 
While this role is highly focused on backend engineering, we value engineers who understand how their systems drive user-facing experiences and who enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to deliver meaningful product outcomes.

The Role

We're looking for a Frontend Engineer to join the Care Platform Operations team at Ro. 

We build the products and workflows providers and care teams use to deliver care through Ro every day, including patient-provider messaging, appointment scheduling, task routing and queues, and operational tools for providers, pharmacists, care coordinators, and patient advocates. These are complex, data-dense workflows where strong frontend engineering directly affects how efficiently and safely care gets delivered.

You'll be the frontend specialist on a full-stack product team, working closely with backend engineers, Product, Design, Data, Clinical, and Care Operations. You'll own problems end-to-end, helping shape the product and technical approach, making tradeoffs across the frontend and backend, shipping the experience, and learning from how it performs in production.

We're looking for someone with deep frontend expertise who thinks beyond the UI and is comfortable navigating ambiguity, dependencies, and product decisions to deliver the right outcome.

lists.content:
• Own complex frontend product areas from problem definition through architecture, implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Build accessible, reliable, high-performance applications in React and TypeScript for providers and care teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to shape scope, sequencing, and product decisions rather than only implementing predefined requirements.
  • Translate complex clinical and operational workflows into intuitive interfaces that reduce friction and manual work for care teams.
  • Make deliberate frontend architecture decisions across component design, application state, data fetching, API contracts, error handling, and performance.
  • Work with backend engineers to design clear boundaries and contracts between frontend and backend systems.
  • Navigate cross-team dependencies and work through ambiguity with Engineering, Product, Design, Clinical, Data, and Operations partners.
  • Use qualitative user feedback and quantitative data to understand whether what we shipped worked and identify where to improve it.
  • Own quality after launch, including testing, accessibility, observability, reliability, performance, and production issues.
  • Contribute to our shared frontend architecture, design system, engineering standards, code reviews, and technical design docs.
  • Help other engineers make better technical decisions through mentorship, design feedback, and collaboration.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and take ownership of the health of the systems your team operates.

lists.text: What You'll Bring to the Team
lists.content:
• Significant recent experience building production applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience building complex, stateful product workflows, such as multi-step forms, scheduling, messaging, queues, or data-dense applications.
  • Strong frontend fundamentals across component architecture, state management, API integration, accessibility, performance, testing, and failure-state design.
  • Experience owning meaningful product work from technical design through production, including making architectural decisions and supporting what you ship.
  • A track record of partnering closely with Product and Design on user-facing products, not just receiving finalized requirements.
  • Experience working across multiple systems, teams, or dependencies to deliver a product outcome.
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to engineering and non-engineering partners.
  • Evidence of using user feedback, product data, or operational metrics to evaluate and improve what you build.

• Experience in healthcare, telehealth, clinical workflows, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience building software for specialized internal or operational users, such as clinicians, support teams, financial operators, or other domain experts.
  • Experience contributing to a shared design system or large frontend monorepo.
  • Familiarity with tools such as TanStack Query, React Aria, Playwright, Storybook, or Chromatic.
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve either product workflows or engineering workflows.

• Full medical, dental, and vision insurance + OneMedical membership
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

descriptionBody:
The Role

We're looking for a Frontend Engineer to join the Care Platform Operations team at Ro. 

We build the products and workflows providers and care teams use to deliver care through Ro every day, including patient-provider messaging, appointment scheduling, task routing and queues, and operational tools for providers, pharmacists, care coordinators, and patient advocates. These are complex, data-dense workflows where strong frontend engineering directly affects how efficiently and safely care gets delivered.

You'll be the frontend specialist on a full-stack product team, working closely with backend engineers, Product, Design, Data, Clinical, and Care Operations. You'll own problems end-to-end, helping shape the product and technical approach, making tradeoffs across the frontend and backend, shipping the experience, and learning from how it performs in production.

We're looking for someone with deep frontend expertise who thinks beyond the UI and is comfortable navigating ambiguity, dependencies, and product decisions to deliver the right outcome.

The Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on Ro’s Identity and Privacy team, you will build and scale systems that support secure user identity and privacy-first data practices. This includes authentication, user lifecycle management, consent, and data governance—ensuring Ro’s technical foundation supports both patient trust and business growth.

You will design, build, and maintain systems that manage customer identity, data preferences, attribution, and event-driven data flows. This work requires strong expertise in distributed systems, event pipelines, and privacy-preserving architectures. lists.content:
• Build and maintain privacy-first, distributed data systems and consent management systems that comply with consumer privacy regulations.
  • Design and operate high-throughput, event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, streaming systems) for collection, processing, and distribution of first-party data.
  • Contribute to authentication and identity systems, including user lifecycle management, access controls, and multi-factor authentication.
  • Architect and scale asynchronous data pipelines and event processing systems for real-time and batch use cases.
  • Partner with marketing and growth teams to enable privacy-compliant advertising, CRM, and analytics workflows.
  • Implement privacy-preserving techniques (e.g., anonymization, tokenization, minimization) and ensure compliant data flows to third-party platforms.
  • Collaborate with security and legal teams to enforce data governance, retention, and compliance policies.

lists.text: What You’ll Bring to the Team
lists.content:
• 8+ years of software engineering experience (2+ years at Staff or above level) with a focus on distributed systems, data infrastructure, privacy, or security.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience building scalable, production-grade systems.
  • Deep experience with distributed systems, including streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka), event-driven architectures, and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience designing and operating data pipelines, eventing systems, and first-party data platforms.
  • Familiarity with authentication and identity systems (e.g., OAuth, session management, MFA, user lifecycle management).
  • Experience using agentic coding tools to improve development velocity, reduce workflow friction, automate repetitive tasks, and increase system visibility—while maintaining strong engineering judgment and ownership of outcomes.
  • Experience in regulated environments and strong ownership in driving complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
